series_key: integrating mql5 with data processing packages
mechanism: On a rolling window of log returns, compute normalized Shannon entropy via percentile bins of returns plus entropy of squared returns (vol_entropy). VolatilityRegimeDetector keeps entropy/std history and classifies LOW / NORMAL / HIGH / EXTREME using adaptive thresholds mean±1.5σ (and extreme at mean±2.5σ or vol_entropy>0.9). Regime drives lot/SL/TP multipliers and signal thresholds.
data_needed: Rolling bid/close window (e.g. 50 ticks or H1 closes); RSI optional; entropy history deque (~50–100).
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: XAUUSD.m; tick-level live EA; H1 training CSV Jan–Apr 2026
why_new_for_mis: Gives MIS a tick-capable disorder sensor that maps continuously into discrete volatility regimes and adaptive risk multipliers, not just ATR level.
quote: By applying Shannon entropy to rolling windows of recent prices, the system instantly detects transitions between low, normal, high, and extreme volatility regimes.

series_key: integrating mql5 with data processing packages
mechanism: Track last_entropy across requests; delta_entropy = current − previous. Entropy momentum = last − first over a short entropy_history deque. Rising delta_entropy widens buy/sell probability thresholds and adds confidence penalty; used as a real-time regime-change / uncertainty-acceleration sensor.
data_needed: Sequential entropy values from build_features; short deque (e.g. 10).
why_new_for_mis: Treats the derivative of market entropy as a first-class change sensor—detects volatility regime shifts as they accelerate, not only after candle closes.
quote: if delta_entropy > 0.02:  # Increasing entropy = increasing uncertainty — buy_threshold += 0.05; sell_threshold -= 0.05

series_key: integrating mql5 with data processing packages
mechanism: Detect swing highs/lows (window=3); each swing is a graph node with features [price, tick_volume, swing_type ±1], edges chain consecutive swings bidirectionally. Label liquidity if ≥3 other swing prices lie within 1.0 of the node price. Train 3-layer GCN (LiquidityGNN); ONNX inference in EA draws zones when softmax P(liquidity)>MinLiquidityScore.
data_needed: OHLCV H1 bars; swing window; node/edge tensors; ONNX GCN.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: XAUUSD.m H1; Nov 2025–Feb 2026 train; backtest Dec 2025–Jan 2026
why_new_for_mis: Casts liquidity pools as a graph over structural swings rather than sequential indicators—MIS can sense where stop clusters likely sit before reaction.
quote: if a price level is touched multiple times within a small range, it is labeled as a potential liquidity zone; otherwise, it is labeled as a normal level.

series_key: integrating mql5 with data processing packages
mechanism: Context agent pulls EURUSD, GBPUSD, USDJPY (~50 M5 bars). usd_strength = (−eur_change − gbp_change + jpy_change)/3 over last 20 bars. usd_strength>0.01 → bearish gold bias; <−0.01 → bullish. Weighted into multi-agent consensus with symbol agents.
data_needed: Live closes of EURUSD, GBPUSD, USDJPY; 20-bar percent changes.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: XAUUSD target; EURUSD, GBPUSD, USDJPY context; M5; schedule ~5 min
why_new_for_mis: Builds a live USD-strength macro sensor from correlated majors to gate gold decisions—cross-symbol regime context beyond single-chart TA.
quote: EURUSD and GBPUSD down = USD strong, USDJPY up = USD strong — usd_strength = (-eur_change - gbp_change + jpy_change) / 3

series_key: integrating mql5 with data processing packages
mechanism: Feature volatility_ratio = std(close, VOL_FAST=20) / std(close, VOL_SLOW=100) with sample std (ddof=1) matched in MQL5 StdDevSample. Combined with atr_rel, rsi_momentum, ema_distance in a 9-feature contract for each EMA crossover.
why_new_for_mis: Relative short-vs-long realized-vol ratio is a compact expansion/contraction sensor MIS can attach to any signal bar.

series_key: integrating mql5 with data processing packages
mechanism: Simulate every EMA12/26 crossover trade (exit at opposite cross or MAX_HOLD_BARS), label profit/loss. FLAML searches LGBM/XGB/RF to predict P(profit) from nine context features at signal bar. EA runs ONNX and trades only if P(profit)>InpConfidence—filters signals by market-state quality rather than taking every cross.
data_needed: Labeled crossover dataset; ONNX model; same 9 features live on closed bar.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: XAUUSD H1; threshold table 0.50–0.70; backtest May–Jul 2026
why_new_for_mis: Turns historical outcome context into a live confidence sensor that gates mechanical signals—MIS can score edge quality per regime.
quote: Only signals the model is confident in get executed.

mechanism: Nested swing search with lookback z∈[7,10] builds X-A-B-C-D-E; validates HS geometry (head above shoulders, neckline D≈B, shoulder E≈A) via inter-leg extremes; entry on close through neckline D, SL at E, TP at X or ≥1:2 RRR. Dual use as pattern highlighter and automated reversal EA.
data_needed: OHLC + time arrays; bars_check (~1000); IsSwingHigh/Low; chart objects.
why_new_for_mis: Rule-based multi-swing structural reversal sensor MIS can emit as a discrete regime-change event with neckline break confirmation.
quote: reversal patterns… indicate that a new trend may be beginning in the opposite direction and that the existing trend may be ending.
